summary: Claude invoked hyperpowers:brainstorming, ran the full architectural spec-doc path (clarifying questions → design sections → spec file at docs/hyperpowers/specs/), presented the spec for approval before writing any implementation code, and on "looks good, go ahead" moved to hyperpowers:writing-plans.
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria are supported by observed screen text, on-disk files, and the session log's tool_use sequence. The brief was escalated to the full spec-doc path, the spec was surfaced for approval before implementation, and implementation only began after my approval. Notable side issues (spec gitignored, empty Codex gate) are recorded as observations, not criteria failures.

observations.description: The agent wrote the spec into docs/hyperpowers/specs/ but then created a .gitignore containing 'docs/superpowers' and 'docs/hyperpowers', explicitly preventing the spec from being committed ('not committed; I added a .gitignore with docs/hyperpowers so it stays that way'). git status confirms only '?? .gitignore' is untracked-visible; the spec is invisible to git. If the process intends a committed spec artifact, this defeats it.

Codex review gate degraded: 'Codex returned empty again. That's an incomplete call — one shot, no retry, never blocking.' Agent noted preflight ok (version 0.0.0-stub) but both the approach gate and the spec review returned empty {}, so the spec ran without independent review; logged as ungated 20260917T031139Z-93430-12812.
The agent read skill files from an absolute path outside the workdir (/Users/.../hyperpowers/.worktrees/brainstorming-trigger/skills/...), which is surprising for a supposedly isolated run.
AskUserQuestion multi-select widgets require arrowing past every option to reach 'Submit'; easy to accidentally submit empty. Minor friction, not a defect.
Spec filename is dated 2026-09-16 while the ledger entry timestamp is 20260917T031139Z — off-by-one/timezone inconsistency in dating artifacts.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use listing (jq over the run's .jsonl) begins with: 'Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming' as the first tool call, before any Read/Write.

criteria.criterion: Classified as ARCHITECTURAL; wrote spec to docs/*/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Log shows 'Write .../coding-agent-workdir/docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md'; ls of workdir shows docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md. Screen: 'Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md'.

criteria.criterion: Spec surfaced for review and approval before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Please review the spec and let me know if you want changes before I write out the implementation plan.' git status in workdir showed only '?? .gitignore' — no app code changes; tool log shows no Write/Edit to index.html/app.js/src before approval.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: No in-chat-only design; a spec file exists on disk at docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md and the agent said 'Design approved across all three sections. Writing the spec.'

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / present throwaway probe plan
criteria.evidence: No mention of spike or probe on screen; agent proceeded design → spec → 'Invoking writing-plans — the only next step on this path.'
